ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a model diagram of ocean currents around an ideal continent, marking two dashed latitude lines, the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn; the ocean currents around the continent are numbered from ① to ⑥, among which the ocean current numbers near the Tropic of Capricorn and on the two sides of the southern part of the continent are ⑤ and ⑥. Then reason: In geographic laws, what flows counterclockwise in middle- and low-latitude sea areas is the Southern Hemisphere subtropical circulation. Corresponding this law to the two ocean currents near the Tropic of Capricorn in the figure, they can be determined as ⑤ and ⑥. The question asks which of these two ocean currents has the smaller number, so the answer is 5.

raw_record.question_text:
If the following figure is a “model diagram of ocean current distribution around an ideal continent,” read the figure and answer: Among the two ocean currents that correctly reflect the rule of “counterclockwise flow in middle- and low-latitude sea areas,” the one with the smaller number is ____.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中大陆周围标有北回归线、南回归线等纬线，南回归线附近的大陆两侧有编号⑤、⑥的洋流。根据地理规律，中低纬度海区若呈逆时针环流，应位于南半球副热带环流。把这一规律对应到图中南回归线附近的两支洋流，可锁定为⑤和⑥。题目要求这两支洋流中编号较小者，因此填5。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中为一块理想大陆周围的洋流模式图，标出了北回归线和南回归线两条虚线纬线；大陆周围的洋流编号为①到⑥，其中南回归线附近、大陆南部两侧的洋流编号是⑤和⑥。再推理：地理规律中，中低纬度海区呈逆时针方向流动的是南半球副热带环流。把这一规律对应到图中南回归线附近的两支洋流，可确定为⑤和⑥。题目问这两支洋流中编号较小的是哪一个，因此答案是5。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the diagram as an ideal continent with dashed latitude lines labeled 北回归线, 赤道附近/南回归线, and numbered currents around both coasts. Identify that the two numbered currents in the southern middle-low-latitude sea area are ⑤ on the southwest side of the continent and ⑥ on the southeast side.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the wording “中低纬度海区逆时针方向流动” to select the Southern Hemisphere gyre, and “编号较小” to choose the smaller of the two identified numbers.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In middle-low latitude oceans, the subtropical circulation in the Southern Hemisphere flows anticlockwise, while the Northern Hemisphere counterpart flows clockwise. The diagram’s southern low-latitude region corresponds to the anticlockwise case.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use basic diagram-reading conventions: north is up, south is down, and an anticlockwise circulation is one whose branches turn around a loop opposite to clock hands. Latitude labels show that the relevant lower loop is the middle-low-latitude southern ocean.
